newsitem.title: USA: U.S. STOCKS EXTEND LOSSES, BURDENED BY WEAK BONDS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. STOCKS EXTEND LOSSES, BURDENED BY WEAK BONDS.

text.p: The Dow industrials slid below the 8,000-point level in afternoon trading on Monday and Nasdaq extended losses as persistent weakness in the bond market continued to drag stocks lower.
The Dow industrials lost 33 points, or 0.40 percent, to 7998, as the long bond moved to session lows. It was down 15/32 at a 6.67 percent yield.
Rising bond yields have put markets on edge about the possibility of inflation and higher rates. Investors awaited July retail sales and price data for further insight.
The Nasdaq composite fell 21 points to 1577.
